nodes.description: Address registry contract holding the addresses of core, data provider, configurator, oracle and fee provider; trusted root of the protocol.
Reference to LendingPoolCore which physically holds all deposited funds and reserve state.
Reference to LendingPoolDataProvider used for health factor and collateral valuations.
Reference to IFeeProvider used to compute origination fees.
Cached lending pool address; used by the onlyLendingPool modifier to gate all state-mutating and transfer functions.
Mapping of reserve address to ReserveData struct (rates, indexes, LTV, liquidation parameters).
Mapping of user and reserve to UserReserveData (principal borrow, stable rate, fee, last update timestamp, collateral flag).
Mapping granting a third party the right to redirect a user's interest stream; consumed as an access-control check in redirectInterestStreamOf.
Last normalized income index recorded per user; divisor used when computing cumulated aToken balances.
Balance redirected by other accounts that accrues interest for the target address.
Owner address controlling every onlyOwner administrative setter of the addresses provider.
Mutex counter read and incremented by the nonReentrant modifier to detect nested calls.
Revision of the last executed initializer; guards against re-running initialize on an already initialized proxy.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the implementation address used by the fallback delegatecall.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address checked by the ifAdmin modifier.
Caller controlled by the attacker; used for authorization checks, as borrower/user identity and as ETH refund recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp driving interest accrual and stored as lastUpdateTimestamp.
Entry point depositing underlying assets, minting aTokens and forwarding funds to the core reserve.
Called by the aToken to burn tokens and send the underlying asset (ERC20 or ETH) back to the user.
Borrow entry point validating collateral, fees and rate mode before updating core state and transferring funds.
Repay entry point handling repayments on behalf of other users, fee transfers and ETH refunds.
Flashloan entry point: transfers funds to an arbitrary receiver, invokes executeOperation, then requires the balance to be restored with fee.
Liquidation entry point performing a delegatecall into the liquidation manager address obtained from the registry.
Swaps a user borrow position between stable and variable rate modes.
Rebalances a stable borrow rate and computes the rebalance-down threshold with ray arithmetic.
Transfers a reserve asset to a user; for ETH it performs a low-level call with gas(50000) to an arbitrary address.
Pulls an ERC20 or receives ETH into the reserve and refunds excess ETH to the caller through a low-level call.
Pushes repaid fees to the fee collection address, with an ETH low-level call for the ETH reserve.
Transfers liquidated origination fees to the fee destination using safeTransfer or a low-level ETH call.
Payable fallback that only accepts ETH from contracts (EXTCODESIZE check) to support flashloan flows.
Updates reserve and user borrow state, indexes and lastUpdateTimestamp when a borrow occurs.
Updates principal/collateral reserves and the liquidated user state including timestamps and fees.
Redeems aTokens for the underlying asset, cumulates interest, burns tokens and calls the lending pool.
Overridden transfer that enforces the transfer-allowed check (health factor) before moving aTokens.
Mints aTokens on deposit; restricted to the lending pool via onlyLendingPool.
Redirects another user's interest stream after checking msg.sender against the stored redirection allowance.
Grants a third party the allowance to redirect the caller's interest stream.
Computes accrued interest since the last update, mints the increase and refreshes userIndexes using the reserve normalized income.
Assembly delegatecall forwarding calldata to the implementation address and bubbling the result.
Creates a new InitializableAdminUpgradeabilityProxy or upgrades the existing one and calls initialize(address(this)).
Owner-only setter that swaps the lending pool implementation behind the proxy.
Returns the stored lending pool proxy address from AddressStorage.
Owner-only ownership transfer to a new address.
Modifier incrementing _guardCounter, caching it locally and requiring it to be unchanged after the body executes.
Modifier enforcing that initialize can run only once per implementation revision.
Delegatecall target implementing the collateral/origination-fee liquidation logic and ETH/ERC20 transfers.
Initializes the proxy implementation and admin; callable once because it requires an empty implementation slot.
Admin-gated upgrade that also delegatecalls arbitrary data into the new implementation.
Low-level call.value().gas(50000) sending ETH to an attacker-controlled destination; external code runs before state finalization.
Arbitrary untrusted contract invoked through executeOperation during a flashloan while the pool holds reentrancy-protected state.
delegatecall into the registry-supplied liquidation manager executes external code in the storage context of the LendingPool proxy.
Assembly delegatecall forwarding arbitrary calldata to the implementation stored in the EIP-1967 slot.
delegatecall of caller-supplied data into a freshly registered implementation after an admin upgrade.
Raw sstore into the implementation and admin slots, bypassing Solidity storage layout guarantees.
Cumulative interest, index and redirected-balance arithmetic executed with SafeMath/WadRayMath; rounding and ordering affect solvency.
Reserve address supplied to deposit().
Amount supplied to deposit() and propagated to the core transfer.
Address on whose behalf the repayment is made in repay().
Attacker-chosen flashloan receiver contract address.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the flashloan receiver.
Recipient address of the core transferToUser low-level value call.
User whose interest stream is redirected; its allowance mapping is checked against msg.sender.
Destination of the interest stream redirection.
New implementation address passed to the admin-gated upgrade and then delegatecalled.
New lending pool implementation address supplied by the owner.
Registry address used to wire the proxy implementation during initialize.
BorrowLocalVars memory struct caching LTV, collateral, fee and rate-mode values inside borrow().
RepayLocalVars memory struct caching borrow balances, fees and ETH flag inside repay().
Locally cached available liquidity compared against the redemption amount.
Cached copy of _guardCounter used by the nonReentrant modifier to detect nested calls.
Interest accrued since the last update, minted during cumulateBalanceInternal.
Return value of the assembly delegatecall in Proxy._delegate, branching between revert and return.

edges.reason: deposit() uses msg.sender as the depositing user for AToken minting and ETH/ERC20 transfer.
redeemUnderlying() forwards the user address into core.transferToUser for the payout.
borrow() uses msg.sender as the borrower for health factor checks and fee calculation.
repay() uses msg.sender as the repayer and as ETH refund recipient.
borrow() passes msg.sender as _user into core.updateStateOnBorrow.
redirectInterestStreamOf requires msg.sender == interestRedirectionAllowances[_from], the only authorization for moving another user's interest.
allowInterestRedirectionTo writes interestRedirectionAllowances[msg.sender], the attacker-controlled authorization entry.
onlyOwner on setLendingPoolImpl relies on msg.sender == _owner to protect implementation upgrades.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner, which compares msg.sender with _owner.
msg.sender is both the writer and the checked subject of the interest redirection allowance mapping.
Ownable constructor sets _owner = msg.sender and isOwner compares msg.sender to it for all administrative setters.
The core fallback requires msg.sender.isContract() before accepting ETH, an EXTCODESIZE-based check on an untrusted caller.
ifAdmin compares msg.sender against the stored admin before allowing upgradeToAndCall.
updateStateOnBorrow writes user.lastUpdateTimestamp = block.timestamp, which governs subsequent interest accrual and therefore value flows.
updateStateOnLiquidation stores block.timestamp as lastUpdateTimestamp, controlling the accrued interest used in liquidation math.
cumulateBalanceInternal derives the minted amount from the reserve normalized income, which is a function of block.timestamp via calculateLinearInterest.
deposit() calls core.transferToReserve.value(msg.value), which can perform a low-level ETH refund call to the depositor.
redeemUnderlying() calls core.transferToUser, which sends ETH through a low-level call to a user-supplied address.
transferToUser executes _user.call.value(_amount).gas(50000) for the ETH reserve, handing control to the recipient.
transferToReserve refunds excess ETH with _user.call.value(excessAmount).gas(50000).
transferToFeeCollectionAddress performs a low-level ETH value call to the destination address for the ETH reserve.
liquidateFee performs a low-level ETH value call to the fee destination address.
flashLoan executes receiver.executeOperation on an attacker-chosen contract while the pool state is only nonReentrant-protected.
flashLoan transfers the requested amount to the receiver via core.transferToUser before invoking the callback.
liquidationCall delegatecalls the registry-supplied liquidation manager with caller-controlled arguments.
Proxy._delegate performs the assembly delegatecall that routes arbitrary calldata to the implementation.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls caller-supplied data into the newly registered implementation.
updateImplInternal deploys and initializes a new proxy with address(this) as admin, so only correct gating keeps the registry authoritative.
updateImplInternal calls proxy.upgradeToAndCall(_newAddress, params) on already registered proxies.
AToken.redeem invokes pool.redeemUnderlying, which then sends ETH to the user, creating a re-entry path between the aToken and the pool.
mintOnDeposit cumulates the account balance before minting the new deposit.
_transfer and executeTransferInternal cumulate both sender and receiver balances before moving tokens.
cumulateBalanceInternal computes and mints the accrued interest, so rounding or ordering errors directly inflate balances.
borrow() updates core reserve/user state through core.updateStateOnBorrow.
repay() moves the repaid amount into the reserve through core.transferToReserve.
rebalanceStableBorrowRate computes rebalanceDownRateThreshold with rayMul/add on the current stable rate, deciding whether a rebalance executes.
updateStateOnBorrow mutates ReserveData totals and indexes through updateCumulativeIndexes and total borrows updates.
updateStateOnBorrow adds the borrowed amount and accrued interest to the user principal borrow balance and origination fee.
updateStateOnLiquidation decreases reserve total borrows by the liquidated amount and compounds the interest first.
updateStateOnLiquidation increases the user principal by accrued interest then subtracts the liquidated amount and fee.
updateImplInternal reads the proxy address from AddressStorage and rewrites it, so the registry controls which implementation is delegatecalled.
onlyLendingPool requires lendingPoolAddress == msg.sender before transferToReserve can pull funds.
onlyLendingPool gates transferToUser, preventing arbitrary callers from draining the core via the ETH value call.
onlyLendingPool gates liquidateFee and its low-level ETH call.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is written with sstore in _setImplementation and read with sload by the proxy fallback.
ADMIN_SLOT is written with sstore in _setAdmin and read by _admin used in ifAdmin checks.
_guardCounter is incremented and compared by the nonReentrant modifier to detect nested calls.
deposit is marked nonReentrant, so the guard counter bounds re-entry during token and ETH transfers.
redeemUnderlying is marked nonReentrant, protecting the ETH payout path.
borrow is marked nonReentrant, protecting the fund transfer to the borrower.
repay is marked nonReentrant although it performs ETH transfers and refunds.
flashLoan is marked nonReentrant even though it calls an arbitrary receiver contract mid-execution.
liquidationCall is marked nonReentrant while delegatecalling external liquidation code.
The initializer modifier reads lastInitializedRevision to decide whether the initializer may run.
The initializer guard controls whether the proxy initialize function can wire the implementation and admin.
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize the lending pool implementation swap.
onlyOwner reads _owner to authorize ownership transfer.
The locally cached guard counter is compared with the storage value after the body to detect reentrant calls.
The cached available liquidity bounds the redeemable amount before the ETH/ERC20 transfer occurs.
_reserve selects the AToken and core reserve used by deposit.
_amount is the deposit size used for minting and the core transfer.
_amount flows into core.transferToReserve for the actual asset pull.
_onBehalfOf determines whose borrow position is reduced and validated during repay.
_receiver determines the flashloan target and the aToken transfer recipient.
_params is attacker-controlled calldata forwarded verbatim to the flashloan receiver.
_receiver is the contract invoked through executeOperation, i.e. the re-entry point during the flashloan.
_user is the destination of the low-level ETH value call inside transferToUser.
_from indexes interestRedirectionAllowances, the mapping consulted to authorize the caller.
_to becomes the new interest redirection target written to storage.
newImplementation is stored in the implementation slot and then delegatecalled with the supplied data.
_pool is the new implementation address written through updateImplInternal.
_addressesProvider is stored during initialization and drives all registry lookups.
BorrowLocalVars caches the borrow checks' intermediate values inside borrow.
RepayLocalVars caches balances and fee values inside repay.
The accrued balance increase is minted as new aTokens, so an arithmetic error here dilutes or inflates supply.
The delegatecall return value determines whether the proxy reverts or returns the raw returndata to the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: The reserve parameter only selects the target reserve for the deposit flow and has no independent meaning.
The amount parameter is a scalar input consumed entirely by deposit and the subsequent core transfer.
The beneficiary address is only used to select the borrow position inside repay.
The receiver parameter defines the flashloan callback target and is fully determined by the flashLoan flow.
The params blob is opaque data forwarded to the receiver and carries no semantics outside flashLoan.
The recipient address is only meaningful as the destination of the core payout call.
The source user is used solely for the allowance lookup that gates the redirection.
The destination address only selects the new redirection target stored by the function.
The new implementation address is consumed entirely by the upgrade and delegatecall routine.
The pool address is forwarded directly into the proxy deployment or upgrade step.
The registry address is stored once during proxy initialization and has no other role.
The memory struct exists only to avoid stack-too-deep inside borrow and is fully scoped to it.
The memory struct aggregates repay intermediates and never escapes the function.
The cached liquidity value is a transient check local to the redeem flow.
The cached counter is the guard's own working variable and belongs to the modifier.
The balance increase is the minted interest amount, directly feeding the accrual arithmetic sink.
The delegatecall result is only used to branch inside the assembly delegatecall sink.
